name: local-failover-b-stops
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). The controller installs A > B > C with D as A's backup (D is installed first). B stops at 12 s. A notices on its own (HELLO timeout, or failed link-layer sends) and switches to D before the controller's replacement route arrives; the controller then confirms A > D > C as the new route.
